summary: Tested fax cover pages, the dashboard fax banner, Fax help articles and diagrams, and ran regression on fax send/bulk. Backend: 19/19 pass after 1 fix (new test_cloudivr_fax_cover.py 10/10 + test_cloudivr_fax_fixes.py 9/9). Unit test test_fax_cover_report.js 18/18. Frontend: cover toggle/fields, single quote (2 pages incl. cover), no-cover quote (1 page), quote reset on cover edit, send + history (2 pages Delivered), bulk 2x2=4 pages, fax-help-link to help?topic=fax ('For this page: Fax'), Help Fax group with 6 articles and 5 diagrams on desktop and 390px with no overflow, dashboard banner open/help/dismiss persists after reload: all PASS. The fax line toggle regression and the Bob check were not finished (the browser run stopped on a selector error).

minor.issue: FIXED: cover JSON that parses to a non-object (e.g. '123') plus 'to' returned 500 (strict-mode TypeError on cover.toFax). It now returns 400 bad_cover.

design_issues.screen: Help > How do I send a fax? (FaxDiagrams.js Step dashed)
issues: The '2. Cover page' step card uses border-dashed border-white/25, which is invisible in the light theme, so the card shows no border
Price diagram labels are very small and low contrast
Number chips are cut off ('+1 415…'); acceptable but looks clipped

action_items: Fix the light-theme border on the dashed Cover page step in FaxDiagrams
Optional: FaxCard hardcodes 50 free pages / $2; take them from the pricing API
Optional: FaxCard dismiss uses remember('preferences'), so it does not persist if the user declined preference cookies
Optional: fix '1 pages' pluralisation in the Bulk faxes card
critical_code_review_comments: fax.js /fax/stage needed an object type guard for the cover (fixed)
Bulk cover uses one Recipient for all numbers and no per-number To fax: fine but worth documenting

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (line toggle and Bob checks not finished)
